shortDescription: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Thursday that principles on foreign exchange established since the coordinated Japan-US intervention remain in effect.Katayama also said she would not comment on foreign exchange levels.

children: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Thursday that principles on foreign exchange established since the coordinated Japan-US intervention remain in effect.
Katayama also said she would not comment on foreign exchange levels.
